acceptance_criterion.criterion: compare its measured 120 C hold behavior with the original references
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: candidate shows clearly worse hold drift than the original reference formulations

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Compositionally matches the normalized E5 reference, whose measured 120 C hold drift was substantially higher than E1 over 15-60 min.

selection_rationale: S1C01 is the normalized composition of E1, the reference with the lower observed 120 C hold drift among the hold-tested references: 708.7 to 776.1 viscosity units from 15 to 60 min, versus 2210 to 3349 for E5. This supports selecting S1C01 for direct validation without assuming an unmeasured candidate result.

evidence_coverage.note: Thermal-hold data are available for E1 and E5 only; candidate outcomes are unmeasured.

extrapolation.note: Selection relies on composition correspondence to the measured E1 reference, not a validated candidate model.

measurement.note: No thermal-hold measurement is supplied for any candidate.

process_history.note: Candidate process history is not supplied.
